threads.body: In my opinion this is not a good name for the test since callbacks not running is probably not the only symptom of the failure, the span should also be missing. Perhaps it would be better to name the test according to what it does like `requestWithInetAddress`
could add a comment that here `-1` used in the `HttpHost` gets replaced with the actual server port
In my opinion it is better to create a span with `testing.runWithSpan("callback", () -> {});` and verify the presence of the span. Thant will automatically give you the context propagation check.
since `failed` and `cancelled` aren't called not much point in incrementing the counters
